name: Code Server
description: VS Code in the browser (code-server), opening on the whole workspace at /opt/aw-workspace (mounted read-write, at the same path the workspace itself uses, so files edited here really save) with a persistent $HOME so extensions and CLI agent logins (claude / codex / copilot) survive container recreates. Ported from the agentic-workspace monolith's code-server integration (src/api/routes/code_server.py, src/mcp/vscode.py, tools/code-server/).

skills.description: Open a file or folder in the workspace's browser-based VS Code from an agent session, via the open_file MCP tool this app registers.

auto_start.title: Auto-start
auto_start.description: Start the Code Server container when the workspace starts.
